question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: This is a short passage describing the life and activities of Abraham Lincoln. Born in 1809, he is famous for his Gettysburg Address. He took part in Black Hawk War. He was a two times president of the USA in 1861 and 1864 respectively. He banned slavery from America. Unfortunately, he was assassinated in Washington in 1865.
